ayahs.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚ لَهُ الۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ الۡحَمۡدُؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shai 'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنۡكُمۡ كَافِرٌ وَّمِنۡكُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee khalaqakum faminkum kaafirunw wa min kum mu'min ; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَاَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqqi wa sawwarakum fa ahsana suwarakum wa ilaihil maseer
ayahs.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tusirroona wa maa tu'linoon; wallaahu 'Aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُؗ فَذَاقُوۡا وَبَالَ اَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Alam yaatikum naba'ul lazeena kafaroo min qablu fazaaqoo wabaala amrihim wa lahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهٗ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَبَشَرٌ يَّهۡدُوۡنَنَاؗ فَكَفَرُوۡا وَتَوَلَّوۡا وَّاسۡتَغۡنَي اللّٰهُؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahoo kaanat taateehim Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati faqaaloo a basharuny yahdoonanaa fakafaroo wa tawallaw; wastaghnal laah; wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
ayahs.en: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: زَعَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ لَّنۡ يُّبۡعَثُوۡاؕ قُلۡ بَلٰي وَرَبِّيۡ لَتُبۡعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡتُمۡؕ وَذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Za'amal lazeena kafarooo al-lany yub'asoo; qul balaa wa rabbee latub'asunna summa latunabba'unna bimaa 'amiltum; wa zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer
ayahs.en: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy."

ayahs.ar: فَاٰمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوۡلِهٖ وَالنُّوۡرِ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَاؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Fa-aaminoo billaahi wa rasoolihee wannooril lazeee anzalnaa; wallaahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
ayahs.en: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ الۡجَمۡعِ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ التَّغَابُنِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۭۡ بِاللّٰهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَالِحًا يُّكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّاٰتِهٖ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ ذٰلِكَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Ywma yajma'ukum li yawmil jam'i zaalika yawmut taghaabun; wa many-yumim billaahi wa ya'mal saalihany yukaffir 'anhu sayyi aatihee wa yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaaa abadaa; zaalikal fawzul 'azeem
ayahs.en: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi aayaaatinaaa ulaaa'ika ashaabun naari khaalideena feehaa bi'sal maseer
ayahs.en: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اَصَابَ مِنۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۭۡ بِاللّٰهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهٗؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Maaa asaaba mim musee batin illaa bi-iznil laah; wa many yu'mim billaahi yahdi qalbah; wallaahu bikulli shai;in Aleem
ayahs.en: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

ayahs.ar: وَاَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوا الرَّسُوۡلَۚ فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَاِنَّمَا عَلٰي رَسُوۡلِنَا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Wa atee'ul laaha wa atee'ur Rasool; fa in tawallaitum fa innamaa 'alaa Rasoolinal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.en: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wa 'alal laahi falyata wakkalil mu'minoon
ayahs.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡ وَاَوۡلَادِكُمۡ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمۡ فَاحۡذَرُوۡهُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ تَعۡفُوۡا وَتَصۡفَحُوۡا وَتَغۡفِرُوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanooo inna min azwaaji kum wa awlaadikum 'aduwwal lakum fahzaroohum; wa in ta'foo wa tasfahoo wa taghfiroo fa innal laaha ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اَمۡوَالُكُمۡ وَاَوۡلَادُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ عِنۡدَهٗ٘ اَجۡرٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa amwaalukum wa awlaadukum fitnah; wallaahu 'indahooo ajrun 'azeem
ayahs.en: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.

ayahs.ar: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ مَا اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَاسۡمَعُوۡا وَاَطِيۡعُوۡا وَاَنۡفِقُوۡا خَيۡرًا لِّاَنۡفُسِكُمۡؕ وَمَنۡ يُّوۡقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fattaqul laaha mastat'tum wasma'oo wa atee'oo waanfiqoo khairal li anfusikum; wa many-yooqa shuha nafsihee fa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ تُقۡرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنًا يُّضٰعِفۡهُ لَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ شَكُوۡرٌ حَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: In tuqridul laaha qardan hasanany yudd'ifhu lakum wa yaghfir lakum; wallaahu Shakoorun Haleem
ayahs.en: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.
Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
